description:
Perform a spatial join to determine which polygon each point falls within, then export the result.

1. Open QGIS (it should already be running).
2. Add the polygon layer from /home/ga/GIS_Data/sample_polygon.geojson using Layer > Add Layer > Add Vector Layer.
3. Add the point layer from /home/ga/GIS_Data/sample_points.geojson.
4. Run a spatial join: go to Vector > Data Management Tools > Join Attributes by Location. Set the input layer to sample_points (the point layer). Set the join layer to sample_polygon (the polygon layer). For the geometric predicate, select 'within' or 'intersects'. For join type, select 'Take attributes of the first matching feature (one-to-one)'. Click Run.
5. The output should contain the original point features with additional attributes from the polygons they fall within (including the polygon 'name' and 'area_sqkm' fields).
6. Export the joined result: right-click the output layer > Export > Save Features As. Choose GeoJSON format. Save to /home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/points_with_polygon_info.geojson.
